name: What are the common exit strategies for rental properties?

mainEntity.name: What are the common exit strategies for rental properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common exit strategies include selling to another investor, selling to an owner-occupant, or executing a 1031 exchange. Selling to an investor often involves a quicker sale but potentially a lower price, while selling to an owner-occupant might yield a higher price but could require more effort in property preparation. A 1031 exchange allows you to defer capital gains taxes by reinvesting sale proceeds into a like-kind property, which is a valuable consideration for continuous investors in areas like Fort Lauderdale and Palm Beach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common exit strategies include selling to another investor, an owner-occupant, or executing a 1031 exchange to defer capital gains.
